open_points.subject: FlowConstant StoredValue resolution
open_points.text: `value`: the `value_id` of a StoredValue (M21) ...; a run delivers that StoredValue as it is.
open_points.question: Which module owns reading the StoredValue record referenced by a FlowConstant, so that `flows` can inspect its schema and class during proof and `runs` can deliver its bytes, given that non-surface modules may not decide from raw `store` records?
options: `flows` owns the lookup and exposes resolved constants through `read_flow_version`
`store` exposes a typed StoredValue lookup that `flows` and `runs` may use
A separate value-owning capability resolves `value_id` for both modules
open_points.default_guess: Have `flows` resolve its constants through a typed store lookup and return each constant with its StoredValue to `runs`.
